dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior terminal point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal; the lateral margins are largely smooth with a slight asymmetrical bulge on the mid-left flank.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light grey; high median pixel intensity across the majority of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse, diffuse grey clusters located primarily on the posterior third of the dorsal surface and lower lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual tonal shifts between the light baseline and darker posterior regions with no sharp edge gradients.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One small, distinct dark pixel cluster located on the mid-dorsal plane, slightly left of the central axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A pronounced longitudinal linear groove/indentation casting a shadow along the central-posterior dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible longitudinal linear scar or structural crease on the mid-dorsal ridge.
